prior_knowledge: Phase 5 inspected TEST signals: max_separation, witness onset, counter_reset ticks.

Envelope bounds/statistics already fitted on campaign normal train in Phase 5; no campaign IF fitted and no campaign detector predictions/scores evaluated on test. Synthetic IF blindness experiments were run.
Hypotheses are about DETECTOR behaviour; they are not blind to test DATA.

metrics.unknown_policy: unknown -> no alarm; y=1 -> FN; unknown counts reported per detector; y=0 operational no-alarm counted TN, explicitly called operational TN rather than a normal judgement
metrics.precision_note: base-rate dependent (design 27.12%); not operational precision; may compare descriptively on this fixed test, not extrapolate to deployment

delay.definition: first alarm tick in [inject+1, revert] minus (inject+1)
delay.summary: median over detected incidents + n_censored; no mean

uncertainty.method: cluster bootstrap by run_id, stratified by group (C, F)
uncertainty.per_fault_type: no CI (2 runs/type); report per-run values
uncertainty.resampling: sample 2 C and 8 F run_ids independently with replacement, preserve all rows/tick order, recompute ratios per seed; detectors not refitted
uncertainty.undefined_replicates: omit undefined ratios and report valid replicate count; all undefined => CI None

comparison_sets.primary: all 590 rows, same mask, same metric code

metrics.zero_denominator: undefined metric is None with denominator/count reported; no zero substitution
metrics.seed_summary: mean, sample std(ddof=1), min, max over five fixed seeds; bootstrap CI computed per seed, not pooled seed rows
metrics.fpr_denominators: control118; fault-run normal312; all430; judgeable negatives detector-specific (IF412/env426); secondary common-judgeable uses identical rows

iforest.quantile_method: numpy.quantile(method=linear) on finite train scores; equality to threshold => no alarm

envelope.primary: k > K, k = strict bound violations over 71 columns
envelope.K_rule: K = max held-out k over GroupKFold(config_id, n_splits=4)
envelope.secondary: excess > E, E = max held-out excess, range floor = campaign.SEPARATION_FLOOR
envelope.cv_refit: each fold refits link_stats, selection, bounds on fold-train only
envelope.cv_protocol: GroupKFold(4, shuffle=False) on normal config_id; refit all preprocessing and selection on fold-train; drop warmup then deltas per run; calibrate max finite k across judgeable validation rows; refit final bounds on all472 normal rows; save learned K in new Phase6 model artifact, never edit Phase5 K=0 manifest
envelope.secondary_formula: excess = sum_j max(lo_j-x_j, x_j-hi_j, 0)/max(hi_j-lo_j, floor_j); unknown iff any selected x_j missing; E=max excess on judgeable fold-validation rows; alarm strictly excess>E
envelope.calibration_failure: stop if any fold has no judgeable calibration row; report calibration counts, no fallback K

hybrid_or.rule: alarm iff any JUDGEABLE member alarms; unknown iff all members unknown

iforest.report: mean, std, min, max over seeds

random_noise_control.what: IF on independent synthetic Gaussian matrices464x72train and590x72test, apply campaign IF unknown mask for equal coverage; no feature selection on test noise
random_noise_control.rng_rule: default_rng(10000+seed), draw train then test; IF primary config/q=0.01; report as synthetic control, not a trained campaign detector

loss_only_ablation.columns: only 8 raw link-*.traffic.lossPct columns from full envelope; exclude drop/state/rate/aggregate
loss_only_ablation.rule: refit loss-only bounds/K independently in normal4fold CV; unknown if any of8missing; primary mask

hypotheses.claim: On the 2 admin_down runs, envelope recall >= IF recall (mean over seeds, primary config).
hypotheses.mechanism: state_up/links_down constant on train -> only envelope sees them; link-s1-s2 rates reach 0 in train (min=0) so rate-only view is ambiguous there.
hypotheses.refuted_if: envelope recall < IF mean recall on admin_down (pooled 40 ticks).
hypotheses.comparison_config: primary mask, max_samples256, q0.01; IF mean five seeds unless hypothesis specifies each seed

hypotheses.claim: On F-degrade-s2-s3: envelope delay = 1 tick, every primary IF seed delay = 2 ticks, loss-only envelope delay in [9, 11].
hypotheses.mechanism: tick 21 unknown for both (counter_reset); tick 22 unknown for IF only (d1 NaN); full envelope contains link-s2-s3.txRate with train band [268256, 271142] B/s; lossPct first crosses at tick 31.
hypotheses.refuted_if: envelope delay is not 1, any primary IF seed delay is not 2, or loss-only delay is outside [9,11]; censored also refutes.
hypotheses.caveat: n = 1 run: an observation, not a statistical test.
hypotheses.comparison_config: primary mask, max_samples256, q0.01; IF mean five seeds unless hypothesis specifies each seed

hypotheses.claim: IF-only positive ticks (caught by IF, missed by envelope) >= 8 (5% of 160) in >= 4 of 5 seeds.
hypotheses.mechanism: degrade s1-s2 has no loss witness and wide train rate bands may hide a low-intensity shift; IF has d1.* and multivariate combinations.
hypotheses.note: recall_hybrid >= max(recall_env, recall_IF) is a TAUTOLOGY of the OR rule, not a hypothesis.
hypotheses.comparison_config: primary mask, max_samples256, q0.01; IF mean five seeds unless hypothesis specifies each seed

hypotheses.claim: Among 4 config folds, the held-out vary fold has the highest held-out alarm rate for BOTH envelope (share of rows with k>0) and IF (q=0.01).
hypotheses.mechanism: SCHEDULE_A contains 5 Mbps and +/-3..4 Mbps steps; fixed configs stop at 4 Mbps with no steps -> extrapolation. 4M fold is covered by vary -> interpolation.
hypotheses.refuted_if: another fold has a strictly higher rate for either detector.
hypotheses.comparison_config: held-out normal folds; envelope uncalibrated k>0 alarm rate, IF mean five primary-seed alarm rates; vary ties for highest allowed

hypotheses.claim: FPR on C-vary > FPR on C-load2M for both detectors.
hypotheses.mechanism: SCHEDULE_B has a 1->5 Mbps step (+4) absent from SCHEDULE_A (max +3); C-load2M equals a train config.
hypotheses.comparison_config: operational FPR on all59ticks of each C run; IF mean five primary-seed FPR; judgeable-only FPR reported separately

run_predictions.envelope: lower FPR than C-vary, narrow rate bands may still trigger
run_predictions.iforest: lower FPR than C-vary; not guaranteed near q
higher FPR than C-load2M around untrained load steps

run_predictions.iforest: rate zero may be familiar in train
run_predictions.delay: 0 expected for envelope; IF may be censored

run_predictions.iforest: low to moderate recall; temporal/multivariate changes may help

run_predictions.iforest: relatively high recall expected, subject to fitted train threshold
